question: Former Karnataka CM ______ received the Padma Vibhushan at Rashtrapati Bhavan in New Delhi for his contribution in the field of Public Affairs in 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**SM Krishna**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **SM Krishna** received the Padma Vibhushan at Rashtrapati Bhavan in New Delhi for his contribution in the field of Public Affairs in 2023.
 
• He is a former Chief Minister of Karnataka and has held various significant positions in the Indian government.
 
• The Padma Vibhushan is India's second-highest civilian award and is given for exceptional and distinguished service in any field including service rendered by Government servants.
 
• SM Krishna has been an influential figure in Indian politics, particularly in Karnataka, and has contributed significantly to public affairs.
 
• His contributions have been recognized at the national level, exemplifying his dedication and service to the nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **SM Krishna** served as the Chief Minister of Karnataka from 1999 to 2004.
 
• He has also held the position of Minister of External Affairs of India from 2009 to 2012.
 
• The Padma Vibhushan was instituted in 1954 and is awarded for exceptional and distinguished service in any field including service rendered by Government servants.
 
• The award is part of the Padma Awards, which include Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri, and are announced annually on the occasion of Republic Day.
 
• SM Krishna's receipt of the Padma Vibhushan highlights his long and distinguished career in public service and his contributions to Indian politics and governance.
